env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

! logos build -o $WORK/bin/bad$GOEXE ./bad
stderr 'bad/b\.go:\d+:\d+: \[perf::zeroalloc_violation\] Load allocates: a\.BigAlloc has no AllocFree fact'
! exists $WORK/bin/bad$GOEXE
logos build -o $WORK/bin/sum$GOEXE ./sum
! stderr .

logos build -o $WORK/bin/local$GOEXE ./local
! stderr .

-- go.mod --
module logostest

go 1.27

-- a/a.go --
package a

func Sum(xs []int) int {
	n := 0
	for _, x := range xs {
		n += x
	}
	return n
}

//go:noinline
func BigAlloc(n int) []byte {
	buf := make([]byte, n)
	buf[0] = 1
	buf[1] = 2
	buf[2] = 3
	buf[3] = 4
	buf[4] = 5
	buf[5] = 6
	buf[6] = 7
	buf[7] = 8
	buf[8] = 9
	buf[9] = 10
	buf[10] = 11
	buf[11] = 12
	buf[12] = 13
	buf[13] = 14
	buf[14] = 15
	buf[15] = 16
	for i := 16; i < len(buf) && i < 96; i++ {
		buf[i] = byte(i)
	}
	return buf
}

-- sum/sum.go --
package sum

import "logostest/a"

//logos:zeroalloc
func Total(xs []int) int {
	return a.Sum(xs)
}

-- bad/b.go --
package bad

import "logostest/a"

//logos:zeroalloc
func Load(n int) []byte {
	return a.BigAlloc(n)
}

-- local/local.go --
package local

import "logostest/a"

//logos:zeroalloc local
func Load(n int) []byte {
	return a.BigAlloc(n)
}
